# Lathmar: The Fallen Depths

> Official website and world archive for Lathmar: The Fallen Depths, a dark fantasy dungeon crawler in development at Sabnock Works.

Lathmar: The Fallen Depths is a party-based Windows RPG inspired by classic 1990s dungeon crawlers. The official site contains the current game overview, development links, and the canonical public lore of Aeltharion.

## Core pages

- [Official website](https://lathmar.de/): Game overview, features, development videos, and community links.
- [The World of Lathmar](https://lathmar.de/world/): Index of the public Aeltharion archive.
- [The Chronicle of Aeltharion](https://lathmar.de/world/chronicle/): Historical account from the age of giants and dragons to the Fourth Age.
- [The Peoples of Aeltharion](https://lathmar.de/world/peoples/): Lore for the ten playable peoples and their place in the present age.
- [Imprint and Credits](https://lathmar.de/legal.html): Publisher, privacy, licences, credits, and acknowledgements.

## Publisher and development

- [Sabnock Works](https://sabnockworks.com/): Developer and publisher.
- [Lathmar on Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/cw/Lathmar_The_Fallen_Depths): Development posts and community support.
- [Development videos](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLcgDIp8yg36x0EB_Khc0fhDquswSnF39M): Official Lathmar development playlist.

The canonical URL for this site and its content is https://lathmar.de/.
